system.summary: Create one solid-seeming illusion that can affect its surroundings (1 HP, CR 1, no Strikes). In combat, while it is Near you (15 ft), enemies must pass a CR 1 Smarts Check to pick the right target or they attack the Mirage. Doom +2.

automation.note: Place a Mirage token (1 HP, CR 1, no Strikes); only one at a time. While it is within 15 ft of you, an enemy choosing a target among you rolls Smarts CR 1 and attacks the Mirage on a failure.
